## Checklist

- [ ] Changes live in the right layer (`app` → `features` → `components` / `config` → `lib`); no new cross-feature deep imports
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit/component next to the code, E2E in `e2e/`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, commands or conventions changed; kit changes use an upstream release and exact dependency pin
- [ ] UI changes: screenshots at 390 px and 1440 px attached
- [ ] UI changes: checked with the keyboard and with reduced motion
- [ ] Local lint, typecheck and targeted tests passed; full suites/build/E2E/Visual verified in CI
